name: Nanatsukigatari
source:
"This time, everyone's in the ghost story." 
Sakura was invited to a storytelling by a girl who loves spooky tales. 
It's one thing to listen; it's another to experience...... 
Nobody knows the chilling conclusion that's to come. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE169809.html]DLsite English[/url]]
